title: Credo (Anonymous, Missa [sine nomine])
desc: Anonymous, attributed to Gaspar van Weerbeke, Missa [sine nomine], Credo. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Ano0207c), edited by Paul Kolb (Gaspar van Weerbeke: Collected Works. II. Masses, Part 2, 2018); encoded by Karina Zybina. CC BY-NC 4.0. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.

poly.lyr: Pa- . trem om- ni- pot- en- tem, fa- cto- rem ce- li et ter- . re, vi- si- bi- li- um om- ni- um et in- vi- si- bi- li- um.
